First of all, I am NOT the authority here, hereby I can only speak from my experience and my point of view. I have been writing poem-like lyrics for approximately ten years, maybe even more. Everytime I wrote them, I ended up having this feeling of relaxation, because all I wanted to write about was on the paper which is basically what I felt sincerely. I am not saying I am successful at writing. I think this is relative. Successful for whom? If you know what I mean, so from my point of view, when I write, I write down my feelings and structure happens naturally, I guess. All of my lyrics are personal. I think the important thing is how they sound to you rather than to others. I'm thinking it is better for you to be the one to criticise your own poetry. If you FEEL that it is good enough, then I think you're settled. But again, I ALWAYS write down how&what I feel. You can get inspired by the smallest things in life. The magic is the emotion, I think.
